title: Joseph of Copertino's levitation records

tellings.quote: have looked at so much data I mean I have the Joseph of copertino Records right yeah and been reading them and they're pretty intense

plain: There are written records of Joseph of Copertino, an Italian saint said to have risen into the air, and the religion scholar Diana Pasulka says she has them and has been reading them. She calls them "pretty intense," bringing them up while talking about how much data she has looked at, with a mention of Hal Puthoff, a physicist who has studied the paranormal. If the records hold, they would be an old, written account of a man seen floating.
